title: Andhere ban mein
body:
andhere ban mein hai baba sakina kyun chali aayi
lahoo mein dooba hai laasha sakina kyun chali aayi
<<DIVIDER>>
na ab neend aayegi tum ko na ab baba sulayenge
hai zakhmi teeron se seena sakina kyun chali aayi
andhere ban mein hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
akeli tum bachi ho baap ki mayyat pe rone ko
yahan hai maut ka pehra sakina kyun chali aayi
andhere ban mein hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
chacha se koi kehde tum abhi tak ran mein pyasi ho
unhi ke paas hai darya sakina kyun chali aayi
andhere ban mein hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
phupi har samt tumko dekhti aur dhoondti hongi
jale qaime mein hai tanha sakina kyun chali aayi
andhere ban mein hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
tumhare waaste jo khoon mein dooba hai darya par
tadap jaata hai wo laasha sakina kyun chali aayi
andhere ban mein hai...
